svg.text: ✓ No Server Management: Zero infrastructure provisioning, patching, or scaling concerns
✓ Automatic Scaling: Each service scales independently based on demand
✓ Pay-per-Use: Only pay for actual requests and compute time consumed
✓ High Availability: Built-in redundancy and fault tolerance across AWS regions
✓ Rapid Development: Focus on business logic rather than infrastructure management
✓ Global Scale: API Gateway edge locations and DynamoDB global tables support worldwide apps
Ideal for: Web applications, mobile backends, IoT data processing, and event-driven architectures
